name: Rick Owens
description: Paris-based designer behind draped, brutalist luxury and cult sneakers like the Geobasket and Ramones.

name: VIVET
description: Streetwear label founded in 2025 by streamer Kai Cenat (Vivet Apparel LLC): tribal-style graphics, a gothic cross logo, denim and leather. Lookalike sites exist; this is the official one.

name: Chrome Hearts
description: LA label known for sterling-silver crosses, gothic hardware and leather.

name: Hellstar
description: Graphic-heavy streetwear label with a cult following in the rap underground.

name: Corteiz
description: London streetwear label built on drop culture and community events.

name: Broken Planet
description: London label known for slogan sweats and limited drops.

name: Sp5der
description: Streetwear label known for puffy web-print hoodies.

name: Denim Tears
description: Tremaine Emory's label, known for cotton-wreath denim that tells a history.

name: Raf Simons
description: Belgian designer whose past collections are among the most hunted in archive menswear.

name: Helmut Lang
description: Minimalist label whose 90s archive is a collector obsession.

name: Undercover
description: Jun Takahashi's Tokyo label with a deep cult archive.

name: Maison Margiela
description: Paris house behind the Tabi and the GAT, with a Martin-era archive collectors revere.

name: Ann Demeulemeester
description: Antwerp label of romantic, poetic black tailoring.

name: Yohji Yamamoto
description: Tokyo designer of draped, oversized black silhouettes.

name: Julius
description: Japanese label of dark, layered, technical-avant clothing.

name: Gallery Dept.
description: LA label of hand-painted, distressed and reworked denim.

name: Kapital
description: Japanese label known for boro patchwork, sashiko and reworked denim.

name: Who Decides War
description: Label of ornate, hand-pieced, stained-glass-inspired denim.

name: Affliction
description: The 2000s label whose tribal and gothic graphics are back in rotation.

name: Ed Hardy
description: Tattoo-art graphics and rhinestones, a 2000s icon revived.

name: Juicy Couture
description: Home of the velour tracksuit.

name: Von Dutch
description: The trucker hat of the 2000s paparazzi era.

name: Salomon
description: French outdoor brand whose trail shoes became a fashion staple.

name: Asics
description: Japanese running brand with archive silhouettes like the Gel-Kayano 14.

name: Bape
description: Tokyo streetwear label behind the Bapesta.

name: Fear of God
description: Jerry Lorenzo's elevated, muted streetwear.

name: Entire Studios
description: Boxy, washed basics in muted and black tones.

name: Balenciaga
description: Paris house whose oversized silhouettes shaped the underground uniform.
